players.product: FUJITSU-MONAKA datacenter CPU (2nm core / 5nm cache-I/O, 3D-stacked), sold standalone and in Fujitsu MONAKA Server

quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report; continuing operations): revenue JPY 1,566.5 billion (+0.9% YoY) as Service Solutions growth outweighed lower Hardware Solutions revenue; adjusted operating profit JPY 121.3 billion (+83.6%), margin 7.7% (4.3%), up in every segment and a record for a first half; operating profit JPY 105.3 billion (+145.0%), the main adjustment item being about JPY 15 billion of European hardware restructuring costs. Profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 262.0 billion (+635.2%), a first-half record, including the Fujitsu General and Shinko Electric share-sale gains. H1 R&D expenses JPY 59.6 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 1,566.5 billion (+0.9%); adjusted operating profit JPY 121.3 billion (+83.6%), margin 7.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): Service Solutions revenue JPY 1,066.5 billion (+4.8%), adjusted operating profit JPY 119.6 billion (+34.8%), margin 11.2%, on continuing DX and modernization demand mainly in Japan; Uvance revenue JPY 311.0 billion (+54.9%), 29% of Service Solutions (20%); modernization JPY 110.1 billion (+33.0%). Global Solutions JPY 249.3 billion (+1.1%) turned profitable (adjusted operating profit JPY 3.8 billion); Regions (Japan) JPY 607.7 billion (+4.2%), margin 16.3%, led by national security and manufacturing; Regions (International) JPY 271.2 billion (-1.6%), adjusted operating profit JPY 16.7 billion. Hardware Solutions revenue JPY 424.8 billion (-7.0%), adjusted operating profit JPY 12.5 billion (+302.1%) on Fsas Technologies' integrated manufacturing-sales efficiency; System Products JPY 346.5 billion (-9.6%); Network Products JPY 78.2 billion (+6.7%) - still sluggish, but base stations and optical transmission equipment both rose year on year. Ubiquitous Solutions JPY 113.1 billion (+4.2%), adjusted operating profit JPY 21.7 billion, margin 19.2%, on Windows 10 end-of-support demand, lower component prices from currency moves and profit-focused selling.
quarterly_data.figure: Service Solutions JPY 1,066.5 billion (+4.8%); Uvance JPY 311.0 billion (+54.9%); Hardware Solutions JPY 424.8 billion (-7.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Next-generation CPU (semi-annual report): Fujitsu is developing the next-generation processor FUJITSU-MONAKA and has strategic collaborations with Super Micro Computer (Supermicro) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD).
